name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 76.7 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.
entries.reference: Jeg skal bruge 3 billetter til i morgen formiddag.

entries.source: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.
entries.reference: Vi er 5 personer, herunder 2 børn.

entries.source: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: Mit telefonnummer er 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.
entries.reference: Flyveturen tager 9 timer og 25 minutter.

entries.source: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.
entries.reference: Vi er 4 personer og har 6 kufferter.

entries.source: Room 214 is on the second floor.
entries.reference: Værelse 214 ligger på anden sal.

entries.source: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.
entries.reference: Jeg ankom den 3. oktober og rejser den 9. oktober.

entries.source: What time does the museum open on Sundays?
entries.reference: Hvornår åbner museet om søndagen?

entries.source: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.
entries.reference: Mit tog afgår klokken 18:45 fra spor 7.

entries.source: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.
entries.reference: Den sidste bus afgår klokken 23:30 i aften.

entries.source: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.
entries.reference: Jeg har en reservation klokken 20 for 2 personer.

entries.source: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?
entries.reference: Åbner apoteket før klokken 9 om morgenen?

entries.source: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.
entries.reference: Turen starter klokken 14:15 og varer 3 timer.

entries.source: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.
entries.reference: Morgenmad serveres fra 6:30 til 10:00.

entries.source: How much is a double room for 3 nights?
entries.reference: Hvad koster et dobbeltværelse for 3 nætter?

entries.source: This costs 45 euros, including tax.
entries.reference: Det koster 45 euro, inklusive moms.

entries.source: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?
entries.reference: Er der rabat for 2 voksne og 1 barn?

entries.source: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.
entries.reference: Billetten koster 12,50 euro pr. person.

entries.source: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?
entries.reference: Kan jeg betale de 78 euro med kort?

entries.source: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?
entries.reference: Hvad koster lufthavnsbussen for 2 personer?

entries.source: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.
entries.reference: Dagens menu koster 15 euro inklusive en drik.

entries.source: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.
entries.reference: Adressen er Calle Mayor 15, tredje sal.

entries.source: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.
entries.reference: Mit hotel ligger på Gran Vía 28, tæt på metroen.

entries.source: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: Ambassaden ligger på Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.
entries.reference: Skriv venligst adressen ned: nummer 42, lejlighed 5B.

entries.source: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.
entries.reference: Mødestedet er Plaza del Sol, port 3.

entries.source: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Er dette vejen til Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Where is the nearest bus stop?
entries.reference: Hvor er den nærmeste busstoppested?

entries.source: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.
entries.reference: Drej til venstre ved lyskrydset og gå derefter ligeud 200 meter.

entries.source: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?
entries.reference: Kan man gå fra stationen til hotellet?

entries.source: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?
entries.reference: Hvilken linje kører til lufthavnen, linje 5 eller linje 8?

entries.source: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?
entries.reference: Undskyld, er dette plads 14A?

entries.source: How do I get to the old town from here?
entries.reference: Hvordan kommer jeg til den gamle bydel herfra?

entries.source: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.
entries.reference: Museet ligger cirka 15 minutters gang fra pladsen.

entries.source: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.
entries.reference: Ring venligst efter en ambulance, en person er bevidstløs.

entries.source: I have lost my passport and my wallet.
entries.reference: Jeg har mistet mit pas og min pung.

entries.source: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?
entries.reference: Hvor er det nærmeste hospital eller klinik?

entries.source: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?
entries.reference: Jeg er allergisk over for peanuts; indeholder denne ret nogen?

entries.source: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.
entries.reference: Nogen stjal min taske med 200 euro i.

entries.source: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
entries.reference: Ring til politiet, tak. Der er sket en ulykke.
